user.title: YOLO Updater
user.description: Add the aggregate update entity. Choose what it may update afterwards under Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: Update categories
init.description: Choose which categories YOLO may install. Anything left off is never installed. HA Core, Operating System, and Supervisor are never installed by YOLO.

exclude_integrations.title: Exclude integrations
exclude_integrations.description: Optionally exclude whole integrations. None of their updates will be installed by YOLO.

exclude_entities.title: Exclude entities
exclude_entities.description: Optionally exclude specific update entities. Entities from integrations you excluded on the previous step are already hidden here.
